name: NHBM Community Sailing Program
operator_name: New Hampshire Boat Museum (with Wolfeboro and Tuftonboro Parks and Recreation)
description_short: Youth sailing lessons for ages 9-16 run by the New Hampshire Boat Museum with Wolfeboro Parks and Recreation at Albee Beach on Lake Wentworth. Beginners start in Optimist dinghies and move to Sunfish; advanced youth can race. Classes run Monday to Thursday, with Friday as a rain date or free sail day.
swim_waterfront_notes: Classes are on Lake Wentworth at Albee Beach, taught by US Sailing certified instructors. Youth sailors must pass the program's own swim test (no certificate substitutes) and be able to climb back onto a boat in deep water.

source.title: Registration Open for Community Summer Sailing Programs - NH Boat Museum

warnings: This is a press release from the museum's Press Room, not the program's schedule or registration page.
The release is dated April 28, 2026 and covers summer 2026, which has already passed (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is shown.
The page lists no dates, prices or youth ages. The only age given is 16+ for keelboat classes.
The program is open to all ages, including adults, so it is not a children's camp only.
The two museum addresses (Moultonborough and Wolfeboro) are not where sailing takes place. Classes are at Albee Beach (Wolfeboro) and 19 Mile Bay (Tuftonboro).
The 'Tickets & Registration' Peek link is a booking link for the whole site. It is not confirmed to be the sailing registration page, so it was left out.
